businessContact.verification: WONY’s official Music Department page expressly authorizes contacting the named Music Director to submit music for airplay. The destination was not decoded, inferred or stored. The plaintext general-station Gmail address was verified as a current station contact but excluded as a substitute submission route. activityVerification.evidence: WONY’s official site exposes a live and currently-playing surface, identifies its 2025–2026 Executive Board, states that more than two dozen DJs broadcast live each week and carries © 2026 site content.

genreFitEvidence: The station describes its programming as a variety of music selected by its DJs.
The Music Department reviews new albums for potential addition to the automation playlist.
The route is appropriate for selected independent electronic, alternative, hip-hop-adjacent and global-fusion MarcsMusic releases, subject to the Music Director’s current programming criteria.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WONY expressly authorizes music-for-airplay contact through its current Music Director, but the destination is non-plaintext and the official pages do not publish attachment-versus-download-link rules, formats, bitrate, file size, release type, metadata, release timing, international eligibility, clean or explicit-content handling, AI-origin policy or response expectations. A human must use the official contact link without decoding or guessing it, confirm the current requirements, select and permission-check the release and complete any outreach manually. The general station mailbox and postal address must not be substituted.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open-pull-request patch was searched for the WONY call sign, station name, canonical domain, Music Department path and named Music Director. No previous music-submission-agent platform or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The named Music Director contact and Music Department airplay invitation are stored as one canonical opportunity. The general station Gmail address and postal address are excluded as alternate music-submission methods.

notes: One new free-first first-party music-airplay route was queued as needs_manual_review. The protected or non-plaintext destination was not decoded or stored, and no outbound action was taken.
